newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia sees further wheat sales to Iraq.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia sees further wheat sales to Iraq.

text.p: The Australian Wheat Board (AWB) expects to sell another 100,000 tonnes of wheat to Iraq under that country's food-for-oil programme, an AWB spokesman said.
However, the AWB had no further immediate statements on sales beyond the 250,000 tonne deal of December 20 for January/February delivery, spokesman Alex Nichol said.
"Our position that we anticipated being able to do 100,000 tonnes a month hasn't changed," Nichol said.
The AWB said on December 20 that it had sold 250,000 tonnes of wheat to Iraq.
Before the Gulf War, Iraq was a consistent buyer of one million to 1.5 milion tonnes of Australian wheat per year.

Iraq has said that wheat will make up more than half of the commodities it will buy with cash raised from oil exports, which resumed in December. Iraq is allowed to export enough oil to raise A$2 billion in renewable six-month steps.
